`; } else if (/订阅源/.test(name)) { let rssUrl = "https://gitee.com/fengying915/yuedu/raw/main/dylb.json"; let RSS = JSON.parse(java.ajax(rssUrl)); let rList = RSS.map(i=>{ let file = i.url; return `${i.name}${i.host}${i.time}${btns(file)}`; }).join("\n"); result = `
订阅合集
合集名称导入
订阅合集${btns("dy.json")}
${rList}
